scenes.audio_narration: Sannu, ekaaro, ndewo class! Welcome back! Today in Primary 4, Baba Tutor is taking you on an exciting visual journey into How Green Plants Manufacture Food (Photosynthesis)! Look closely at the screen as we unlock this together.

scenes.baba_tutor_pose: Interactive presenter, pointing at 3D animated diagram
scenes.audio_narration: Under official curriculum standard NERDC-BST-PRI4-T1-W3, let us break down the core mechanics step-by-step: Step 1: Define photosynthesis as food manufacture by green plants. Step 2: Identify 4 essential requirements: Chlorophyll, Sunlight, Water, Carbon Dioxide. Step 3: State the basic word equation: Water + Carbon Dioxide + Sunlight -> Glucose + Oxygen.
Why does this matter in real life? Whether we are observing the green leaves on a mango tree or sharing a fresh loaf of Agege bread among friends, mathematics and science govern everything we touch!
Fantastic job class! Now take out your exercise books and answer Baba Tutor's quick challenge on screen. Remember: SabiSnap makes every lesson crystal clear. You sabi am well well!
